Adani Defence signs 5-year pact for AK-203 rifle ammunition

Adani Defence & Aerospace has entered into a five-year agreement with Indo-Russian Rifles Pvt Ltd to supply 7.62x39 mm ammunition for AK-203 assault rifles. These rifles are being manufactured in India. The deal aims to bolster domestic defense manufacturing capabilities and support the 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat' initiative.
